name: nd-rating-sync
description: Reads embedded rating tags from music files (FMPS_Rating / POPM / iTunes rtng) and syncs them to Navidrome's user ratings via the Subsonic API.
author: Your Name <you@example.com>

library.reason: Read music files to extract embedded rating tags

subsonicapi.reason: Call setRating to write star ratings back into Navidrome

users.reason: Required by the subsonicapi permission for per-user authorisation

scheduler.reason: Schedule periodic scans of the music library

config.label: Navidrome username
config.description: The Navidrome account whose ratings will be updated. Make sure this user is also added to 'User Access' below.

config.label: Skip already-rated songs
config.description: When 'true' (default), songs that already have a star rating in Navidrome are left untouched. Set to 'false' to overwrite existing ratings from file tags.

config.label: Max songs per scan
config.description: Maximum number of songs to process in a single scheduled run. Use 0 for no limit. Defaults to 500.
